result.explanation: Maintain clock, queued jobs, total bytes, and a monotonic insertion sequence. Expire jobs before every event and again after advancing. Add checks current identity, deadline, and capacity; cancel and run release bytes. Run selects the earliest deadline, then earliest accepted sequence.
result.program: function solve({config,state,event}){let s=state||{now:0,jobs:[],bytes:0,seq:0},now=s.now,j=(s.jobs||[]).map(x=>({id:x.id,size:x.size,deadline:x.deadline,seq:x.seq})),bytes=s.bytes==null?j.reduce((a,x)=>a+x.size,0):s.bytes,seq=s.seq||0;function expire(){for(let i=j.length-1;i>=0;i--)if(j[i].deadline<=now){bytes-=j[i].size;j.splice(i,1)}}expire();let status,ran=null;if(event.type==='add'){let exists=false;for(let i=0;i<j.length;i++)if(j[i].id===event.id){exists=true;break}if(exists||event.deadline<=now||bytes+event.size>config.capacity)status='rejected';else{status='accepted';j.push({id:event.id,size:event.size,deadline:event.deadline,seq:++seq});bytes+=event.size}}else if(event.type==='cancel'){let i=-1;for(let k=0;k<j.length;k++)if(j[k].id===event.id){i=k;break}if(i<0)status='missing';else{status='cancelled';bytes-=j[i].size;j.splice(i,1)}}else if(event.type==='advance'){status='advanced';now+=event.dt;expire()}else{if(!j.length)status='empty';else{let i=0;for(let k=1;k<j.length;k++)if(j[k].deadline<j[i].deadline||j[k].deadline===j[i].deadline&&j[k].seq<j[i].seq)i=k;ran=j[i].id;bytes-=j[i].size;j.splice(i,1);status='ran'}}return{state:{now:now,jobs:j,bytes:bytes,seq:seq},output:{status:status,ran:ran,pending:j.map(x=>x.id),bytes:bytes,now:now}}}
